text: A woodshop has rules so everyone goes home with all ten fingers.
Rule one: always ask a grown-up before you start.
Keep the floor clear. Sweep up scraps so nobody trips.
Put tools back where they live when you are done.
No running and no goofing around in the shop.
Tie back long hair and take off anything that dangles, like a hoodie string.

tip.text: Loose sleeves and strings can get caught in spinning tools.

text: If something feels wrong or scary, stop and get your grown-up.
Stopping is always the right choice.
